subject: Payment gateway timeout errors on Terminal 1 during peak hours
description: Customers are experiencing repeated payment failures when attempting to complete transactions on POS Terminal 1 at the Andheri West location. The error message displays 'Gateway Timeout - Transaction Cancelled' after 30-40 seconds of processing. This issue has been occurring intermittently since this morning around 11:30 AM, with increased frequency during lunch peak hours. Approximately 8-10 customer transactions have failed in the last two hours, affecting customer satisfaction and sales.

ticket_history.note: Ticket acknowledged and assigned for triage. Store manager advised to switch to Terminal 2 for payment processing temporarily to minimize customer impact during peak service hours.
